simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בּוּץ (H948) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 8 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בּוּץ (bûwts) means probably cotton (of some sort) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 21.
